title: BUS Grants Elevate
Off-Gas Grid Support
sub: The Boiler Upgrade Scheme now offers £9,000 for off-gas grid heat pump installations.

rows.label: £9,000 grant for off-gas grid properties replacing oil/LPG.
Temporary measure until March 31, 2027, for higher retrofit costs.
Standard grant remains £7,500; £2,500 for air-to-air heat pumps.
MCS-certified installers apply on behalf of property owners.

sections.title: Key Takeaways
lines: Sustained government commitment to low-carbon heat is evident.
The scheme drives growth in the UK's renewable heating sector.
